items.lede: An aircraft equipped with Joby Aviation's autonomy technology flew across the United States without a human pilot taking control at any point.
items.title: Joby Aviation’s 3,100-mile autonomous flight signals its push beyond electric air taxis

items.lede: The startup is looking to expand beyond electric air taxi rides in major cities.
items.title: Joby Aviation completed a fully autonomous flight from California to North Carolina
